lane: لُخْقُوقٌ [_A sort of trench,_ or _channel, made by water, which has worn and undermined its sides;_] _a place in which water flows, having sides worn and undermined thereby, and hollowed in the form of the river,_ or _river-bed:_ pl. لَخَاقِيقُ. (ISh, TA.)

entries.text: اللخقوق، بالضم: شق في الأرض كالوجار.
